mappings.note: Morphology: separate the mool shabd and pratyay in natakkar, natakiya, vaigyanik, kalpanik, bahutayat. Cited at competency level because the 20-outcome Class 6 Hindi frame has no morphology outcome - C-HIN4.2 is the language-system competency, and its LO-140 covers USING words appropriately when writing, not analysing their formation. NB the item has no key ('self').
